author: SavageAmericans
body: My idea for a new map choosing system: First the system would randomly choose 3 maps. Then the players could vote for any of the 3 maps. The map with the most votes would win and would be chosen. If there are any ties the system randomly selects one of the tied maps.

replies.author: badgg
replies.body:
Issue: Maps that are new will not get the attention if deserves purely because players love to choose maps that are overrated and that they can work well individually. Quintus will be chosen almost everytime if it's picked to vote as players love to killfarm benefiting their kill / death ratio. With the current forced map rotations, all maps between Quintus needs to be played. People will be mad at the voting idea because their favourite maps will never be chosen as the system is based off majority votes. 
(Quintus was used as an example)

Currently, everyone is happy and players may wish to leave the match and select another map.
